name: AS400 / iSeries Monitoring
description: Dashboard for the nri-as400 New Relic Infrastructure on-host integration. Covers system status, memory pools, active jobs, disk usage, job queues, output queues, job temp storage, long-running SQL / blocked jobs, and message queue events.

pages.name: System Overview
pages.description: AS400:SystemStatusEvent - overall CPU, storage, users, and batch job counts

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(percentProcessingUnitUsed) AS 'CPU %' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent`
SELECT latest(currentUsersSignedOn) AS 'Users Signed On' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent`
SELECT latest(numberOfJobsInSystem) AS 'Jobs In System' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent`
SELECT latest(activeThreadsInSystem) AS 'Active Threads' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent`
SELECT average(percentProcessingUnitUsed) AS 'CPU %' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent` TIMESERIES
SELECT average(percentSystemASPUsed) AS 'ASP %' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent` TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Batch Job Queue Counts Over Time

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(numberOfBatchJobsRunning) AS 'Running', average(numberOfBatchJobsHeldOnQueue) AS 'Held', average(numberOfBatchJobsWaitingForMessage) AS 'Waiting For Message', average(numberOfBatchJobsWaitingToRunOrAlreadyScheduled) AS 'Waiting/Scheduled' FROM `AS400:SystemStatusEvent` TIMESERIES

pages.name: Memory & Storage Pools
pages.description: AS400:MemoryStatusEvent - per-pool storage, faults, and thread eligibility

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(mainStorageSize) AS 'Main Storage (MB)' FROM `AS400:MemoryStatusEvent`
SELECT latest(numberOfPools) AS 'Pools' FROM `AS400:MemoryStatusEvent`

SELECT latest(poolSize) AS 'Pool Size (MB)', latest(currentThreads) AS 'Current Threads', latest(maximumActiveThreads) AS 'Max Threads', latest(status) AS 'Status', latest(subsystemName) AS 'Subsystem' FROM `AS400:MemoryStatusEvent` FACET poolName LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Database vs Non-Database Page Faults by Pool

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(databaseFaults) AS 'DB Faults', average(nondatabaseFaults) AS 'Non-DB Faults' FROM `AS400:MemoryStatusEvent` FACET poolName TIMESERIES LIMIT 10
SELECT average(activeToIneligible) AS 'Active→Ineligible', average(waitToIneligible) AS 'Wait→Ineligible' FROM `AS400:MemoryStatusEvent` FACET poolName TIMESERIES LIMIT 10

pages.name: Active Jobs
pages.description: AS400:JobList - per-job CPU, status, and queue information

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(jobName) AS 'Active Jobs' FROM `AS400:JobList`
SELECT average(jobCPUPct) AS 'Avg CPU %' FROM `AS400:JobList`
SELECT latest(jobCPUPct) AS 'CPU %', latest(jobUser) AS 'User', latest(jobStatus) AS 'Status', latest(jobSubsystem) AS 'Subsystem' FROM `AS400:JobList` FACET jobName LIMIT 20
SELECT average(jobCPUPct) AS 'Avg CPU %' FROM `AS400:JobList` TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM `AS400:JobList` FACET jobStatus LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Jobs Currently Waiting On A Message (MSGW)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT jobName, jobUser, jobSubsystem, lastJobLogMsg FROM `AS400:JobList` WHERE activeJobStatus = 'MSGW' LIMIT 50

pages.name: Disk Usage
pages.description: AS400:DiskUsageEvent - per-unit disk capacity and utilization

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(resourceName) AS 'Disk Units' FROM `AS400:DiskUsageEvent`
SELECT max(percentUsed) AS 'Max % Used' FROM `AS400:DiskUsageEvent`

SELECT latest(percentUsed) AS '% Used', latest(capacityMB) AS 'Capacity (MB)', latest(availableMB) AS 'Available (MB)', latest(resourceStatus) AS 'Status', latest(diskType) AS 'Type' FROM `AS400:DiskUsageEvent` FACET resourceName LIMIT 100
SELECT average(percentUsed) FROM `AS400:DiskUsageEvent` FACET resourceName TIMESERIES LIMIT 10

pages.name: Job Queues & Output Queues
pages.description: AS400:JobQueueEvent and AS400:OutputQueueEvent - queue depth and spooled file backlog

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(numberOfJobs) AS 'Jobs', latest(activeJobs) AS 'Active', latest(heldJobs) AS 'Held', latest(releasedJobs) AS 'Released', latest(scheduledJobs) AS 'Scheduled', latest(maximumActiveJobs) AS 'Max Active', latest(jobQueueStatus) AS 'Status', latest(subsystemName) AS 'Subsystem' FROM `AS400:JobQueueEvent` FACET jobQueueLibrary, jobQueueName LIMIT 100
SELECT latest(numberOfFiles) AS 'Spooled Files', latest(outputQueueStatus) AS 'Status' FROM `AS400:OutputQueueEvent` FACET outputQueueLibrary, outputQueueName LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Total Active Jobs Across Job Queues

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(v) AS 'Active Jobs' FROM (SELECT latest(activeJobs) AS v FROM `AS400:JobQueueEvent` FACET jobQueueLibrary, jobQueueName LIMIT MAX)

widgets.title: Total Held Jobs Across Job Queues

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(v) AS 'Held Jobs' FROM (SELECT latest(heldJobs) AS v FROM `AS400:JobQueueEvent` FACET jobQueueLibrary, jobQueueName LIMIT MAX)
SELECT sum(v) AS 'Spooled Files' FROM (SELECT latest(numberOfFiles) AS v FROM `AS400:OutputQueueEvent` FACET outputQueueLibrary, outputQueueName LIMIT MAX)
SELECT count(*) AS 'Held Output Queues' FROM (SELECT latest(outputQueueStatus) AS v FROM `AS400:OutputQueueEvent` FACET outputQueueLibrary, outputQueueName LIMIT MAX) WHERE v = 'HELD'

widgets.title: Spooled File Backlog Over Time (Top 10 Output Queues)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(numberOfFiles) FROM `AS400:OutputQueueEvent` FACET outputQueueLibrary, outputQueueName TIMESERIES LIMIT 10

pages.name: Job Temp Storage & Long-Running SQL
pages.description: AS400:JobTempStorageEvent and AS400:LongRunningSqlEvent - top temp storage consumers and blocked/long-running SQL jobs

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(temporaryStorageMB) AS 'Temp Storage (MB)', latest(jobType) AS 'Type', latest(jobStatus) AS 'Status', latest(subsystem) AS 'Subsystem', latest(authorizationName) AS 'User' FROM `AS400:JobTempStorageEvent` FACET jobName LIMIT 25

SELECT latest(jobStatus) AS 'Status', latest(sqlStatementStatus) AS 'SQL Status', latest(elapsedTimeSeconds) AS 'Elapsed (s)', latest(databaseLockWaitTimeMs) AS 'DB Lock Wait (ms)', latest(nonDatabaseLockWaitTimeMs) AS 'Non-DB Lock Wait (ms)', latest(sqlStatementText) AS 'SQL Text' FROM `AS400:LongRunningSqlEvent` FACET jobName LIMIT 25
SELECT max(temporaryStorageMB) AS 'Max Temp Storage (MB)' FROM `AS400:JobTempStorageEvent`
SELECT uniqueCount(jobName) AS 'Jobs Flagged' FROM `AS400:LongRunningSqlEvent`
SELECT max(temporaryStorageMB) AS 'Max Temp Storage (MB)' FROM `AS400:JobTempStorageEvent` TIMESERIES
SELECT message, severity, job, user, type FROM `AS400:MessageQueueEvent` LIMIT 100
SELECT max(severity) AS 'Max Severity' FROM `AS400:MessageQueueEvent`
SELECT count(*) FROM `AS400:MessageQueueEvent` FACET severity LIMIT 20
